body.x: AEE participated in ‘CES 2018(Consumer Technology Show)’, the world’s largest IT consumer electronics show held in Las Vegas, the U.S.A. from Tues. 9th to Fri. 12th in Jan. and introduced ‘AEE selfly’, a smart phone case with the world’s first unmanned aerial vehicle.

AEE selfly, a smart phone case with unmanned aerial vehicle produced by AEE, a world leading company in the field of electrical and aerospace, and camera technology, offers smart-phone users an incredible selfie with a whole new level of quality and precision in almost every location, height and distance.

AEE Selfly utilizing high-end stabilization technology, is equipped with most 4-6 inch smart phones. This product provides photos and videos with far distance, narrow angles or higher altitude while flying through the user’s command. AEE Selfly with 1080P, Full HD video capability, is fully charged in 30 minutes and can fly for 4 minutes. It is compatible with Apple iOS and Android devices.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
